title: PRAY THIS 6AM FIRE PRAYER EVERY MORNING AND NOTHING WILL STOP YOU THIS WEEK
text: Nothing. That is not enthusiasm. That is a decree. Nothing will stop your breakthrough this week. Not the principality that has been stationed against your advancement. Not the witchcraft altar that has been working against your name. Not the generational pattern that has been repeating in your bloodline. Not the system that has been closing doors before you could reach them. Not the discouragement that has been arriving every midweek to drain the faith. Not the delay that has been holding the answer in transit for months. >> [music] >> Not the sickness that has been making the body a battlefield. Not the lack that has been making the month longer than the money. Nothing will stop it. But hear me, this is conditional. The condition is not your holiness. The condition is not your perfection. The condition is not your record. The condition is this. Pray this fire prayer every morning at 6:00 a.m. Not once. Not on Monday when you are inspired. Not on Thursday when you remember. Every morning. Because the breakthrough does not need one prayer. The breakthrough needs the cumulative force of daily fire. Day one, the fire prayer clears the atmosphere. Day two, the fire prayer holds the cleared ground. Day three, the fire prayer advances into new [music] territory. Day four, the fire prayer dismantles the resistance that reassembled overnight. Day [music] five, the fire prayer is the final blow that brings the breakthrough through. >> [music] >> Day six, the fire prayer protects the breakthrough that arrived. Day seven, the fire prayer becomes the platform for the next level. Seven mornings, seven fires, nothing stopped. Isaiah chapter 62:6-7, "I have set watchmen upon thy walls, O Jerusalem, which shall never hold their peace day nor night. Ye that make mention of the Lord, keep not silence, and give him no rest till he establish until he make Jerusalem a praise in the earth. Keep not silence. Give him no rest till he establish. The watchman on the wall does not pray once and go to sleep. The watchman is there every morning, every evening, day and night, keeping not silence, never holding peace till the establishment comes. That is the 6:00 a.m. fire prayer. >> [music] >> You are the watchman on the wall of your own life and this week you keep not silence. Every morning at 6:00 a.m. the fire is lit and nothing that assembles against the breakthrough can survive seven consecutive mornings of this fire. >> [music] >> Before we pray, share this word immediately as an act of establishing a prayer partner. Send it to someone and say, "Let us both pray this at 6:00 a.m. every morning this week." Because Matthew 18:19, "If two of you shall agree on earth as touching anything that they shall ask, it shall be done for them of my father which is in heaven." Two watchmen on the wall, double fire, double the speed of the breakthrough. Now, the theology of daily morning fire, why 6:00 a.m.? Why every morning? Why fire specifically? These are not arbitrary choices. There is a precise spiritual logic to each one. Why 6:00 a.m. the window of first light? Psalm chapter 5, verses 2 and 3. "Harken unto the voice of my cry, my king and my God, for unto thee will I pray. My voice shall thou hear in the morning, O Lord. In the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee and will look up." In the morning will I direct my prayer. The Hebrew word for direct here is arak. Arak, to set in order, to arrange in battle formation. It is a military word. Not in the morning I will casually mention my request. In the morning, I will arrange my prayer in battle formation. David understood the military value of the morning. The morning is when the day's agenda is still fluid. The morning is when the enemy's deployments are not yet fully operational. The morning is when the believer can set the terms before the day can set its own terms. And 6:00 a.m. is the window just before the world fully wakes. The window between the night watches and the full operation of the day. The window where the spirit realm is most responsive to the decree of the praying child. Lamentations chapter 3, verses 22 and 23. It is of the Lord's mercies that we are not consumed because his compassions fail not. They are new every morning. Great is [music] thy faithfulness. New every morning. The mercies of God are not recycled. They are not yesterday's leftover grace dispensed again today. They are fresh, issued [music] this morning, brand new. And the believer who prays at 6:00 a.m. is the one who meets the fresh mercies at the point [music] of their release. They are not drawing from stale reserves. They are receiving from the morning's fresh issuance. Today's mercy for today's battle. Today's fire for today's resistance. [music] Today's breakthrough anointing for today's closed door. Why every morning? The law of persistent fire. Leviticus chapter 6, [music] verse 13. The fire shall ever be burning upon the altar. It shall never go out. The fire shall never go out. In the tabernacle, the altar fire was a perpetual fire. It was the priest's responsibility to [music] tend it every morning, verse 12. Every morning fresh wood, fresh fuel, renewed flame, not because the fire died overnight. But because the fire required daily maintenance to remain at full strength, the fire of your intercession is the same. [music] It does not die if you miss a morning. But it diminishes, it reduces from a consuming fire to a manageable warmth. And a manageable warmth does not consume the enemies assignments. Only a consuming fire does. Every morning at 6:00 a.m. you bring fresh wood. You [music] tend the altar fire of your intercession. You keep it at the temperature required to consume everything the enemy builds against the day. Seven consecutive mornings, seven days of sustained consuming fire. Jericho did not fall on the first day of marching. Joshua 6, they marched for 6 days. Same walls, same city, same silence. Day after day the priests blowing the trumpets. Day after day the ark carried around the same circuit. And it looked like nothing was happening. But something was happening. The foundations were loosening. The structural integrity of the walls was being undermined by the cumulative force of obedient daily persistent prayer. And on day seven the walls fell flat. Your Jericho will fall by day seven. >> [music] >> If you tend the fire every morning. Why fire? The nature of what fire does. Fire is not a metaphor in this prayer. Fire is a theological reality. Hebrews chapter 12 verse 29, "For our God is a consuming fire." >> [music] >> God is a consuming fire. Not God is like a consuming fire. Not God can be compared to fire in certain respects. God is a consuming [music] fire. His nature is fire. His presence is fire. And when you pray in his name, you are releasing his nature into your situation. Fire does four specific things that this prayer requires. Fire purifies. Malachi 3:2-3, he shall sit as a refiner and purifier of silver. The fire of the morning prayer purifies the atmosphere of the day. It burns out the residue of yesterday's battles. It removes the contamination the enemy left in the atmosphere overnight. It prepares a clean consecrated day for God to walk in. Fire consumes. What fire touches, it consumes. Every assignment, every plan, every strategy the enemy built for the day, the fire of this prayer touches it and consumes it. Not weakens, not damages, consumes. Brought to nothing, reduced [music] to ash. Fire illuminates. In darkness, fire gives light. The fire of the morning prayer illuminates the day. It shows the path that was hidden in the pre-dawn darkness. It reveals the trap the enemy set before you could step in it. It lights the door that was invisible without the fire. Fire [music] ignites. Fire reproduces itself. It spreads. The fire you light at 6:00 a.m. ignites the anointing in your spirit for the day. It ignites the gifts. It ignites the faith. It ignites the boldness that yesterday's discouragement tried to extinguish. [music] And as you carry the fire into the day, it spreads to the people you encounter. [music] The meeting room changes temperature when you enter. The conversation shifts when you speak because you are carrying fire from the 6:00 a.m. altar. Four functions of fire, all four operating in this prayer. >> [music] >> Now, the prayer itself, every morning at 6:00 a.m. this week, the fire that stops nothing from stopping the breakthrough. Stand. [music] Open your mouth. This prayer is prayed out loud always. Silence does not light a fire. >> [music] >> The spoken word is the match. The name of Jesus is the accelerant. [music] And the faith in your spirit is the fuel. Father, I come to the altar of the morning. Leviticus 6:13, the fire shall never go out. I tend the altar this morning. I [music] bring fresh wood. I bring fresh surrender. I bring fresh fire. I come through the blood of Jesus Christ. >> [music] >> The blood that speaks better things than the blood of Abel. Hebrews 12:24. Better things than guilt. Better things than condemnation. Better things than you have prayed this before and it did not work. The blood speaks better things. >> [music] >> It speaks accepted, covered, authorized, heard. And from the position of Ephesians 2:6, [music] seated in heavenly places in Christ Jesus, I light the fire of this morning. >> [music] >> First, fire purify the day. Father, let the fire of your presence purify this day. I address everything the enemy deposited in the atmosphere overnight. The dark assignments he released in the hours of sleep. The witchcraft operations that run between midnight and 3:00 a.m. The contamination he spread through dreams, through the spirit of heaviness, through the [music] low grade dread that arrives before the first thought forms. Fire purify the atmosphere of this day. Isaiah 6:6-7, the seraph with the live coal from off the altar. The coal touches the lips. The iniquity is taken away. The sin is purged. Let the live coal from the altar of heaven touch every contaminated area of this day. The atmosphere purified. The mind purified. Every residue of overnight operation consumed. >> [music] >> The spirit purified. Every attachment the enemy made during sleep severed. I break every evil dream that visited this sleep season. Every dark image, every ominous symbol, every threatening narrative that the enemy used the dream realm to deliver, broken by fire. The dream is not a prophecy, it is an assignment. And the assignment is consumed by the morning fire. I consecrate this day to God. >> [music] >> Romans 12:1, a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable unto God. This day a living sacrifice on the altar, consecrated, set apart, belonging to God from the first hour to the last. The purified, consecrated days now ready. Clean ground for the breakthrough to land on. Second fire, consume every obstacle. Now the fire turns toward the enemy's assembled obstacles. >> [music] >> There are obstacles between where you are and where the breakthrough is. Some natural, some spiritual, some a combination of both. And fire does not negotiate with obstacles. Fire does not walk around them. Fire consumes them. I identify every obstacle to the financial breakthrough and release fire. The spirit of lack that has been working as a gatekeeper on the financial flow, fire consumed. The gate is open. The devourer that has been eating provisions before they arrived, fire. Malachi 3:11, rebuked, consumed. The provision is preserved. The delay on the payment that should have arrived, fire. The withstanding spirit is consumed. The payment is released. >> [music] >> I identify every obstacle to the healing breakthrough and release fire. Every spirit of infirmity fortified in the body, fire. Luke 13:12, "Thou art loosed from thine infirmity." >> [music] >> Every generational sickness pattern using the body as its residence, fire. The lease is expired, >> [music] >> the tenancy is terminated. Every medical report that is not consistent with the report of the Lord, fire. Isaiah 53:2-5, "The report of the Lord stands, the contrary report falls." I identify every obstacle to the destiny breakthrough and release fire. Every closed door that has been withstanding the calling, fire. Isaiah 45:2, "Brass gates broken, iron bars cut asunder." Every voice of discouragement that has been speaking over the assignment, fire. Jeremiah 20:2-9, "His word in my bones is like fire shut up in my bones." [music] The fire in the bones is louder than the voice of discouragement. Every satanic substitute positioned to misdirect the calling, fire. The counterfeit is consumed, [music] the real door remains. I identify every obstacle to the relational breakthrough and [music] release fire. Every root of bitterness that has been defiling the relationships, fire. Hebrews 12:15, "The root is [music] consumed before it can spread further." Every spirit of strife positioned [music] in the marriage, the family, the ministry, fire. The strife [music] is consumed, the door it was holding open for every evil work, shut [music] by fire this morning. Every obstacle consumed, reduced to ash, and the path to the breakthrough [singing and music] is now clear. Third, fire illuminate the path. Father, let the fire of your presence illuminate the path of [music] this day. Psalm 119 to 105, "Thy word is a lamp unto my feet and a light unto my path." >> [music] >> The fire of the word illuminating the next step. Not the whole journey, the next step. Not the full map, the next door. Not the complete strategy, the next obedience. I receive illumination for the decisions of this day. Every high-stakes decision, fire illuminates the right path. Every crossroads moment, fire shows the God door from the counterfeit. Every conversation where discernment is needed, fire operates. >> [music] >> I receive the warning fire. The fire that illuminates the trap before the foot can land in [music] it. Psalm 91 to 3, "He shall deliver thee from the snare of the fowler." The snare is laid in the dark. But the fire of the morning prayer illuminates it before the step is taken. I will see the trap this week before it closes. I will see the counterfeit before I embrace it. I will see the wrong door before I walk through it. Because the fire of the morning prayer is lighting my path. I receive the divine appointment fire. The fire that illuminates the right person in the room. The God connection that I might have walked past without the fire. >> [music] >> The divine appointment that looks ordinary until the fire reveals it. There is a person under this voice. They have been missing divine appointments. Not because the appointments were not there, because the fire was not lit in the morning and the path was dark. The right person was in the room, but the fire was not there to illuminate them. The right door was available, but the fire was not there to reveal it. The right word was being spoken, but the fire was not there to highlight it. The Lord says you have been walking through lit rooms with your eyes adjusted to darkness. This 6:00 a.m. fire prayer is the adjustment. From this morning, the appointments are visible. From this morning, the right person in the room is unmistakable. From this morning, the path is lit. Fourth fire, ignite the breakthrough anointing. Father, let the fire of your presence ignite the breakthrough anointing in my spirit. Acts chapter 2, verse 3. And there appeared unto them cloven tongues like as of fire. And it sat upon each of them. Fire sat upon each of them. >> [music] >> Not on the room, not on the building, on each of them. Personally, specifically, individually. One tongue of fire per person. The most personalized fire in the history of the church. That same fire, personal, [music] specific, targeted, is available every morning at 6:00 a.m. Not the corporate outpouring alone, the individual tongue. The fire that is for you. The fire assigned to your name, your calling, your specific breakthrough. I receive the fire that is for me. Fire, ignite the dormant gift in my spirit. The gift that was operating at 70%. >> [music] >> The anointing that was present but not at full flame. The calling that was alive but not yet fully ignited. Fire, ignite it to full operation. Today, this morning, [music] fire, ignite the boldness that was extinguished by the last rejection. Acts 4:29, grant unto thy servants that with all boldness they may speak thy word. The boldness that was there before the wound. The voice that was loud before the silence was enforced. Fire, reignite the boldness louder than before the wounding. Purer than before the process. More effective than before the delay. Fire, ignite the faith for the specific breakthrough [music] of this week. The faith that corresponds exactly to the size of the door that needs to open. Not generic faith. >> [music] >> Breakthrough specific faith. The kind that looks at the closed door and says, "Jericho fell on day seven, and today might be day seven." Fifth fire, the seal [music] of the day. Father, we seal this day with fire. Every fire that has been released, the purifying fire, the consuming fire, the illuminating fire, the igniting fire, sealed into the atmosphere of this day by the blood of Jesus. >> [music] >> The blood is the permanent seal. What the blood seals, the enemy cannot unseal. The fire that purified this morning, the enemy cannot recontaminate. The obstacle that was consumed, the enemy cannot reassemble before tomorrow. The path that was illuminated, the enemy cannot redarken. [music] The anointing that was ignited, the enemy cannot re-extinguish. [music] The day is sealed, and I go into it carrying the fire. Zechariah 2:2-5, "I will be unto her a wall of fire round about." The fire is not just in me, it is around me. >> [music] >> A wall, a perimeter, a barrier the enemy cannot breach. Every assignment that approaches this day >> [music] >> meets the firewall first and retreats. I release the angels assigned to this day into full operation. Psalm 91:11, "He shall give his angels charge over thee." Charge, commissioned, assigned, given specific instruction. Angels, go before me into every room, every road, every conversation of this day. Prepare what needs to be prepared. >> [music] >> Protect what needs to be protected. Deliver what has been assigned for this specific day, and I declare this day's outcome before it unfolds. Romans 4:17, calling those things which be not as [music] though they were. This day I advance, not retreat. This day doors open, not close. This day the breakthrough moves closer, not farther. This day I am favored, not forgotten. This day I am protected, not exposed. This day I am heard in heaven, not ignored. This day I carry fire into every room, into every conversation, into every moment where the enemy expected darkness. Father, thank you for the 6:00 a.m. window. Thank you that the mercies are new every morning. Thank you that the altar fire never goes out. Thank you that you are a consuming fire and you live in me. Thank you that what lives in me is greater than what is assembled against me. 1 John 4:4, "Greater is he that is in you >> [music] >> than he that is in the world." The fire in me is greater than the obstacle before me. The fire in me is greater than the principality against me. >> [music] >> The fire in me is greater than the wall between me and the breakthrough. And seven mornings of releasing that fire, nothing will stop the breakthrough. There is a minister under this voice. They have been ministering from discipline for a long time. They still show up. They still preach. They still serve. But the fire, the original fire has reduced to embers, and they feel it every time they stand to minister. The words come, but without the heat they once carried. The Lord says the embers are enough. Embers are not dead. They are waiting for breath. This 6:00 a.m. prayer is the breath of God on the embers. I decree the fire that was there in the beginning returns this week, brighter, hotter, purer, refined by the process it survived. The people who encounter this minister this week will encounter something different from last week. The fire is back. [music] There is a young woman she has been believing for a financial miracle for 6 months. >> [music] >> She has tithed, she has given, she has stood on Malachi 3, she has confessed and declared and believed, [music] and the miracle has not yet visibly arrived. And last week she almost stopped believing. The Lord says do not stop now. The fire prayer you are praying this week is the final day of marching. The walls of Jericho fell on day seven, not day six. On day six they looked exactly like they had on day one. Same walls, unchanged, but the seventh day was different. I decree this week is the seventh day. The walls of the financial delay fall this week. Keep the fire lit. Keep marching. Day seven is here. Shondai Ecclesia re tumbala. Kaishondai re Ecclesia. Tumbala shondai kairi Ecclesia. Shondai tumbala kairi Ecclesia re. The siege is over. Pray this every morning at 6:00 a.m. Not as a ritual, as a declaration of war. Day one, the atmosphere is purified. Day two, the obstacles are consumed. Day three, the path is illuminated. [music] Day four, the anointing is ignited. Day five, the day is sealed and the angels are deployed. Day six, the walls look unchanged, but the foundations are shaken. Day seven, the walls fall. And nothing will have stopped the breakthrough. Not because you were powerful enough, because you were faithful enough. You tended the altar fire every morning. You brought fresh wood every morning. You stood at the 6:00 a.m. window every morning and met the fresh mercies at the point of their release. Walk into your favor. It has been waiting. On the other side of seven mornings of fire in the cleared atmosphere on the illuminated path. Through the open door that the consuming fire cleared of [music and singing] every obstacle, your destiny is preserved by the blood. [music] Your week is governed by the daily fire, and the God who is himself a consuming fire, who lives inside the one who prays this prayer, [music] is greater than every obstacle, every principality, every wall between here and [music] the breakthrough. 1 John 4:4, "Greater is he Greater is he that is in you >> [music] >> than he that is in the world." Seven mornings, seven fires, one breakthrough. Nothing will stop it. [music] From this altar you go as a fire carrier. Into every room the temperature changes when you enter. [music] Into every conversation the fire speaks through your voice. >> [music] >> Into every closed door, the fire of the breakthrough anointing precedes you. And tomorrow morning 6:00 a.m., the altar is waiting. >> [music] >> The wood is ready. Tend the fire. >> [music] >> It is done. The fire is lit. The atmosphere is purified. The obstacles are consumed. The path is illuminated. The anointing is ignited. The day is sealed. The week is covered. And nothing, absolutely nothing, will stop the breakthrough. Tomorrow 6:00 a.m., the altar is waiting. Amen [music] and amen.
